NASAL DISCHARGE
A runny nose indicates an irritant in the nasal passages. Because irritants also
produce sneezing, these two signs tend to occur together.
Excited and nervous dogs often secrete a clear, watery mucus that drips
from the nose. This type of discharge is not accompanied by sneezing and dis-

gagging and retching indicates a postnasal drip. A discharge from one nostril

This condition, once called the senile or old dog syndrome, is a newly recog-

Disorientation is one of the principal symptoms of cognitive dysfunction
